reference_sql:
WITH versions AS (
  SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS n_versions
  FROM price_history
  GROUP BY product_id
),
checks AS (
  SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS n_checks
  FROM competitor_prices
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.product_id, v.n_versions, COALESCE(c.n_checks, 0) AS n_checks
FROM products p
JOIN versions v ON v.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN checks c ON c.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.brand IN ('Vistara', 'Sonora')
